decisions.reason: A classic lever handle line close to the core offer in a growing industry likely meets aspirations, and the large firm's slack lets it carry the product at low cost.
A multi-model handle family close to the established range fits the system breadth strategy, and there is no shortfall signal that would trigger problemistic search.
A single handle design carries slightly higher risk of pruning, but after only one year with growing turnover and ample slack, management has little reason to drop it.
A single design close to the core costs little to keep listed, and satisfactory industry conditions give no cause to reallocate resources.
A lever handle family that strengthens the system offering is likely to perform at aspiration level in a growing market.
The flagship electronic access system embodies the strategic move toward digital building organization, so slack and commitment justify carrying it even while its results are uncertain.
